cancellation_summary: Cancellations & Rebookings require 48-hour Advanced Notice.  Only Refundable Tickets Available for a Refund.
location_address: 74-381 Kealakehe Parkway Suite E Kailua-Kona, HI US 96740
description: Visit one of Kona’s most beautiful and exclusive local snorkeling spots, only accessible by boat.  Only a handful of visitors get to snorkel here each day, and you could be one of them! Our afternoon snorkeling trip takes place in Pawai Bay (pronounced Pa-vai) – ocean permitting.  This beautiful lava rock coastline is set aside for the use of native Hawaiian children, inaccessible to non-natives from shore.

what_is_not_included_items.value: Personal swimwear - come with your swimsuit on and ready to snorkel

itinerary:
We are fortunate to be able to moor in the bay and share the beautiful shallow reef wildlife and educational briefings with guests about the wildlife we encounter. This secluded location is a true local gem and is known as one of the most beautiful local snorkel spots in Kona.

Just after boarding, we depart Kona’s harbor, keeping a watchful eye out for *Hawaiian spinner dolphins in their natural habitat. Jump in the water to snorkel Kona’s most beautiful local snorkel spot at Pawai, where massive schools of fish, lava rock arches, and gorgeous reefs await discovery.

You’ll spend less time on the boat and more time in the water.  Plus, it’s likely you’ll have the whole area to yourself.  Kealakekua Bay can get crowded so why not spend the time exploring some of Kona’s local reefs.
check_in_details:
- We run rain or shine (unless it affects safety)
- Minimum of six guests for charter to run. 

*While it typically isn't an issue we do have slower periods of the year it may occur.  If we do not reach our minimum, you'll be offered the option to rebook for a different day. If you are unable to join us on another day, you will have the option for a full refund.  You also have the option to purchase the additional seats to make the minimum, so the tour will run - that also means a private trip for you!*

what_to_bring_items.value: 🚨Full face masks are not permitted on any of our trips due to safety concerns.

special_requirements: Anyone under the age of 18 must be accompanied and supervised by a parent or guardian.
restrictions:
- For safety, basic swimming skills are required to enter the water
Non-swimmers can enjoy the dramatic and spectacular Kona coastline while relaxing in the sun
- Expectant mothers or those with regular back or neck issues are not permitted on this tour due to the adventurous nature of our retired Navy SEAL boat
- We do not recommend our vessel for those 75 and older due to the adventurous nature of our retired Navy SEAL boat
- You must be in good physical and mental health
- For safety, you must be able to converse in English
- We DO NOT RECOMMEND a snorkel trip (due to increased exertion) for at least two days after getting off the plane due to the risk of development of ROPE (Rapid Onset Pulmonary Edema)
disclaimers: Prices vary with demand. Plus tax and fees. Wildlife often appears but isn’t guaranteed.
